description: A small white blocky chair-like piece sits on a blue bedspread in front of a large pink pillow. The left hand stays near the left side of the chair piece to steady it as the right hand reaches in from the right, grips the top-right protruding part, pulls it outward to the right, and lifts it free, then lowers and sets the removed piece down on the bed to the right of the remaining chair structure.
